mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO fcc_flow_instance( id, call_id, flow_definition_id, flow_version_id, status, started_at, context_json ) VALUES ( #{call}, #{call}, #{definitionId}, #{versionId}, 'RUNNING', UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), #{snapshot} )
mapper.select: SELECT current_step_key AS step, status, context_json AS context FROM fcc_flow_instance WHERE id = #{call} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fcc_flow_step_execution( id, flow_instance_id, call_id, stage, step_key, action_type, attempt_no, command_id, trigger_event_id, status, input_json, started_at, ended_at, duration_ms ) SELECT #{id}, #{call}, #{call}, #{step}, #{step}, #{action}, COALESCE(MAX(attempt_no), 0) + 1, #{command}, #{event}, #{status}, #{input}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), CASE WHEN #{step} = 'END' THEN UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) END, CASE WHEN #{step} = 'END' THEN 0 END FROM fcc_flow_step_execution WHERE flow_instance_id = #{call} AND step_key = #{step}
mapper.update: UPDATE fcc_flow_instance SET current_step_key = #{step}, status = CASE WHEN #{step} = 'END' THEN 'ENDED' ELSE 'RUNNING' END, ended_at = CASE WHEN #{step} = 'END' THEN UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) END, context_json = JSON_SET(context_json, '$.executionToken', #{token}), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{call}
